'''Synnoran ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was the descendant of [[Darth Synn]] and the father of a [[Synnoran|daughter]] who lacked [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and joined the Imperial military.
